verdict.rationale: Rainforest is an embedded-payments SaaS platform with a Platform Portal, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no in-product AI assistant or task delegation. The llms.txt docs endpoint and Zapier no-code workflows are adjacent documentation and automation features, not an AI assistant inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
